Ethnic Wear Size & Measurement Guide

Ensure the perfect fit for your celebratory wardrobe. All dimensions are stated in inches unless noted otherwise.

1. Saree Dimensions & Blouse Pieces

All sarees at Kalyani Sarees adhere to standard Indian handloom drape lengths:

  • Saree Length: Standard 5.5 meters (adequate for all traditional and contemporary drapes).
  • Running Blouse Piece: 0.8 meters unstitched fabric attached to the inner end of the saree.
  • Fall & Pico: Complimentary high-quality cotton fall stitching and pico edging is applied to pure silk sarees.
